package rulefixtures

// scenario for nested_append_without_outer_capacity: Append calls inside nested loops without visible preallocation on the outer slice.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
type Item struct{ Tags []string }

func scenario357Positive(items []Item) []string {
	var allTags []string
	for _, item := range items {
		for _, tag := range item.Tags {
			allTags = append(allTags, tag)
		}
	}
	return allTags
}
